title: Tech Note: QuickTime Container 1.2 – More Features
author: Thomas Maul, General Manager, 4D Germany
featured_technology: QTGetTags MP3/ID3 and picture EXIF metadata reading

historical_commentary.text: This note documents version 1.2 of 4D's QuickTime Container plug-in, adding offscreen movie/audio handling, MP3/picture metadata tag reading, and movie-frame screenshot capture, all built on Apple's QuickTime framework. QuickTime itself was deprecated and eventually discontinued by Apple (QuickTime for Windows was end-of-lifed in 2016, and QuickTime Player/frameworks were phased out on macOS in favor of AVFoundation), so this plug-in and its entire command set are obsolete; any modern 4D media-handling requirement would use different, current-generation APIs.
related_updates: Apple deprecated and later discontinued QuickTime (QuickTime for Windows support ended in 2016; macOS long ago transitioned to AVFoundation), making the underlying framework this plug-in wraps obsolete
4D's own media/picture/video handling capabilities have evolved considerably since this 2006-era plug-in, though a direct successor timeline is not confirmed here
